claims.evidence: Witness photos show a dining table set: black metal-framed tables with wooden tops and a rectangular tabletop opening, plus matching chairs/seats; no sewing machine legs are shown.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No sewing machine or motor is visible in the witness photos; the items shown are tables/chairs with a tabletop opening.
The witness report does not provide a price list or confirmation of the stated amount; also the seller’s item description conflicts with the photos.
Location is not shown or confirmed by the witness photos.

risks.risk: Item mismatch/scam risk: seller description is for sewing machine legs/motor, but photos show a dining table set with chairs/seats.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video showing the exact item being sold from multiple angles, including any sewing machine parts if that is what they claim.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used dining table set in worst visible condition (surface wear, unknown stability), not as a sewing machine.

risks.risk: Unknown chair/seat count and completeness (photos don’t show the full set).
risks.proof: Request a photo showing all chairs/seats laid out together with a clear count.
risks.if_unproven: Price for the minimum confirmed pieces only (tables + at least one seat), treating missing chairs as not included.

risks.risk: Tabletop insert material and condition (rectangular opening is visible but insert/glass/stone/wood condition is not).
risks.proof: Request a close-up photo of the insert itself (or confirmation it is missing) and a photo showing it fitted in the opening.
risks.if_unproven: Price as missing/unknown insert condition (worst case: insert missing or damaged).

risks.risk: Structural stability: wobble/looseness of joints, rack/shelf integrity, and rust depth are not fully visible.
risks.proof: Request a short clip where the buyer can see the table legs and lower rack being gently shaken to demonstrate stability.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible looseness/rack wear (worst case: needs tightening/repair).

risks.risk: Hidden damage to wood top (cracks/splits/warping) and finish issues beyond visible light wear.
risks.proof: Request photos of the tabletop edges and underside, plus a close-up of any cracks or chips.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cosmetically worn with potential minor damage (worst case: edge/finish wear).

proof_requests: Send a clear video of the exact item being sold (show the full set and all parts), matching what the photos show.
Confirm the exact number of chairs/seats included with a single photo showing the full set together.
Show the tabletop insert (material and condition) and a photo/video of it fitted into the rectangular opening.
Provide a stability test clip (gentle shake) focusing on the table legs and the lower rack/shelf.
Show close-ups of wood edges and underside, and any rust spots on the metal frame.
response.reason: The seller’s description (sewing machine legs/motor) conflicts with the witness photos (dining table set), so a reliable worst-case price cannot be set without confirming the exact item and completeness.
